collation.title: Compare with the official result
collation.hint: Pick the polling unit, then enter the official figure: from INEC's result viewing portal (IReV), the collation centre, or the EC8B sheet. We compare it with what the witnesses verified on the wall.
collation.failed: Couldn't save the figures. Check your connection and try again.
flag.allPass: Everything on this sheet adds up.
flag.VOTES_CAST_GT_ACCREDITED: The sheet shows more votes cast ({actual}) than voters accredited ({expected}).
flag.ACCREDITED_GT_REGISTERED: The sheet shows more voters accredited ({actual}) than are registered ({expected}).
flag.PARTY_SUM_NE_TOTAL_VALID: The party scores add up to {actual}, but the sheet says total valid votes is {expected}.
flag.VALID_PLUS_REJECTED_NE_CAST: Valid votes plus rejected ballots make {actual}, but the sheet says {expected} votes were cast.
flag.MISSING_FIELD: We couldn't read {label}. Retake the photo a bit closer, or another witness's photo can fill it in.
flag.WORDS_DIGITS_CONFLICT: {label} is written differently in words and in figures. We used the figures.
flag.LOW_CONFIDENCE: Parts of this photo were hard to read (the reader is {pct}% sure). A clearer photo would help.
flag.NOT_A_RESULT_SHEET: This doesn't look like a polling unit result sheet. Photograph the sheet that shows the vote figures.
flag.SHEET_ILLEGIBLE: The photo is too blurry, dark or cut off to read. Please take it again in good light.
home.hero.title: Every result sheet,
home.hero.body: Snap the EC8A posted at your polling unit. We seal it, read it, and check it against what gets announced.
home.stat.mismatch: {n} unit(s) where the announced figures don’t match the wall
home.step1.title: Capture & seal
home.step1.body: Your phone fingerprints the photo (SHA-256) the moment you take it, so any later edit shows.
home.step2.title: AI reads, rules check
home.step2.body: The numbers are read from the sheet, then checked with plain arithmetic rules.
home.step3.title: Witnesses confirm
home.step3.body: Two matching reports can verify sooner. One clear EC8A report can verify after 5 hours; announced figures are then compared against it.
home.setup.title: Your database is empty
home.setup.body: CounTrack is connected to Supabase, but no polling units exist yet. Two steps load the simulated demo:
units.subtitle: Every polling unit CounTrack tracks, with witness status and mismatches. Open one to see its photos, readings and comparisons.
units.search: Search code, name, ward or LGA
units.empty.title: No polling units yet

capture.subtitle: Stand close, keep the whole sheet in frame, and avoid glare.

home.setup.step1: Add your service_role key to .env (Supabase → Project Settings → API)
home.setup.step2: Run the seed script, then refresh this page
home.sticker: Seal it · Read it · Check it ·
home.seal.title: Sealed the second you snap
home.seal.body: Your phone stamps every photo with a SHA-256 fingerprint before it leaves your hand. Change one pixel and the fingerprint breaks, so the evidence speaks for itself.
home.two.title: Two witnesses. One truth.
home.two.body: No single photo decides anything. When two independent witnesses’ sheets read the same, the unit turns verified.
home.two.live: {v} of {n} polling units verified right now
home.demo.title: Does the announcement match the wall?
home.demo.body: Search any polling unit to see its verified wall result next to what was announced. No unit in mind? Drag the example below.
home.roles.title: Pick your part
home.role.witness.title: I’m at a polling unit
home.role.witness.body: Photograph the EC8A on the wall. It works offline and uploads when you’re back online.
home.role.agent.title: I’m a party agent
home.role.agent.body: Enter the figures announced at collation and see at once if they match the wall.
home.role.observer.title: I’m watching the count
home.role.observer.body: Browse every polling unit, its photos, readings and any mismatches.

sol.safety.title: Safety check-ins
sol.safety.notEnough: Not enough check-ins yet to show totals.
sol.safety.notEnough.why: Totals appear once enough people have checked in, so nobody can be singled out.
